title: While Being Seen Off by Campanella
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a breakup with his boyfriend, depressed office worker Kanou thinks of stepping in front of a train, but a high school boy at the station stops him; Kanou nicknames the boy 'Campanella' after a character in a book (Futekiya blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). Meanwhile Kanou is drawn to his boss at work. A one-volume adult boys' love drama about recovering from heartbreak.
life_message: Small kindnesses from strangers and the courage to love again can carry someone out of despair (to verify).

content.note: Opening near-suicide at a train platform (AniList and MangaUpdates blurb).
Adult same-sex romance; AniList tags Nudity (low rank) and MangaDex rates it erotica; extent of sex scenes to verify.
Depression, self-hatred and suicidal thoughts are the starting point (AniList Suicide tag; MangaUpdates Depression and Self-Hatred categories).
Suicide ideation by train; framed as a moment he is pulled back from.

dominant: Recovery from despair; finding love again; LGBTQ life at work
